name: CINELLI 西耐力 Pressure
why_interesting: The exact mainland listing combines the first-generation Pressure frame with Shimano 105 Di2 and 3T Discus carbon wheels; it is kept separate from Pressure 2.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 Di2 2x12 with R7170 controls and hydraulic brakes; exact chainring and cassette selection are not published in the China index
facts.frame_material: High-modulus T800 carbon monocoque frame with proprietary lay-up and carbon-monocoque fork
facts.frame_construction: First-generation Pressure aero platform with fully internal routing, integrated carbon seatpost, Press Fit 86.5 bottom bracket, flat-mount brakes and 12 mm thru axles
facts.wheels: 3T Discus 50 I30 matte carbon wheel option shown in the mainland listing
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Official 2023 first-generation Pressure catalog maximum of 700x30C
facts.stiffness_evidence: An independent exact-generation road.cc review describes a stiff, relatively light frameset with good ride quality; qualitative build-specific evidence, not a numeric stiffness result

missing: Exact complete-bike weight, tire model, cockpit, chainring and cassette for the selected mainland option
Current domestic warranty route and final checkout conditions
source_note: The retained CNY 15,529 snapshot and current JD index consistently identify the first-generation Pressure with 105 Di2/R7170 and 3T carbon wheels. The official 2023 catalog supplies T800 construction and 30 mm maximum clearance. Pressure 2 specifications are not transferred to this record.
